company_blurb: Aurora Freight is a mid-size Nordic logistics and freight-forwarding company specializing in overland routing, port coordination, and cold-chain transport across Northern Europe. Combining regional transport operations with an in-house routing platform, the company prides itself on reliability, punctuality, and practical problem-solving through harsh winter seasons and busy shipping quarters.

departments.culture: Engineering values low-ego collaboration, reliable uptime, and straightforward technical documentation. Standups are brief, code reviews are constructive, and teams balance modernizing cloud services with keeping day-to-day dispatch tools running smoothly.

Finance operates with quiet precision and predictable rhythms centered around monthly closes and seasonal freight forecasts. Team members share a deep respect for accurate spreadsheets, clear audit trails, and unhurried afternoon coffee breaks.

Legal is a small, tight-knit group focused on practical risk management, cross-border transport regulations, and clear contract language. They pride themselves on turning around vendor and client redlines promptly without unnecessary jargon.

Sales blends fast-paced quarter-end energy with long-term relationship building across Nordic shippers and carriers. Collaboration between managers and sales ops is close, with frequent check-ins on pricing, capacity, and renewal timelines.

personas.bio: Kalle Heikkinen is a senior engineer who maintains core routing services and mentors newer developers on legacy integrations. Outside of work, he restores vintage bicycles and enjoys cross-country skiing.

Pihla Nieminen is a financial analyst focused on route profitability and fuel cost forecasting. She joined two years ago from a maritime shipping firm and appreciates clean spreadsheets and quiet mornings.
Sanna Salonen handles CRM workflows and territory reporting in sales operations. Known for keeping pipeline reviews on schedule, she spends her weekends baking sourdough and hiking coastal trails.
Jussi Koskinen is a paralegal who drafts standard carrier agreements and tracks regulatory filings. He is methodical with version control and brews strong filter coffee for the office kitchen.
Iida Jarvinen works as an analyst in Finance, tracking quarterly departmental budgets and vendor spend. She enjoys indoor climbing and often organizes casual lunch outings for her team.
Emma Turunen manages accounts payable and monthly reconciliations as a staff accountant. Reliable during month-end close, she is an avid reader of historical fiction and knitwear designer.
Aino Makinen serves as compliance officer, overseeing customs documentation standards and transport safety regulations. She communicates policies clearly and enjoys kayaking in the archipelago.
Aleksi Lehtinen is a software engineer working on telemetry dashboards and fleet tracking APIs. Enthusiastic about modern tooling, he plays bass in a local indie band after hours.
Laura Tuominen leads regional enterprise accounts as a sales manager. She spends much of her week negotiating freight volume commitments and coaching reps on client presentations.
Elina Heinonen is a tech lead overseeing platform reliability and cloud infrastructure. She favors clear architecture docs, structured sprint planning, and long trail runs before dawn.
Tuomas Laine writes backend services for warehouse scheduling and carrier dispatch. Quiet in big meetings but helpful in code reviews, he spends his free time woodworking.
Janne Virtanen is a tech lead responsible for partner API integrations and data pipelines. He collaborates closely with operations teams to translate logistics edge cases into working software.
Petri Koskinen supports contract renewals and insurance claims documentation in Legal. He has a knack for spotting missing clauses and enjoys playing amateur league floorball.
Antti Karjalainen is a senior engineer specializing in database performance and reporting queries. A long-tenured team member, he knows the history behind almost every schema decision.
Nea Salo coordinates proposal templates, pricing tiers, and quote approvals in sales ops. She bridges communication between account executives and finance with patience and humor.
Pihla Korhonen builds variance models and supports board reporting packages in Finance. Detail-focused and punctual, she enjoys botanical illustration and weekend museum visits.
Eero Tuominen leads the internal tools squad as tech lead, streamlining dispatchers' daily workflows. He advocates for user testing and hosts occasional board game nights.
Lauri Lehtinen serves as controller, guiding audit preparation, tax compliance, and financial controls. He keeps a steady hand on quarterly closes and tends a large vegetable garden.
Aleksi Salonen handles customer invoicing, carrier billing disputes, and ledger entries as an accountant. Patient with complex tariff tables, he enjoys cycling regardless of the weather.
Antti Kinnunen manages mid-market freight partnerships and seasonal shipping contracts in Sales. Quick to celebrate team wins, he spends winter weekends coaching youth ice hockey.
